scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,blue "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run start:dev:local --prefix backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
